edusperience_description: In this project, you will build a personal monthly budget using Google Sheets and the 50/30/20 budgeting rule. This rule suggests spending roughly 50% of your after-tax income on needs, 30% on wants, and 20% on savings and financial goals. You will choose a career, research a realistic salary, and then plan how you would spend your monthly take-home pay across those three categories. Along the way, you will practice key spreadsheet skills including writing formulas, using functions, applying number formatting, and working with absolute cell references. By the end, you will have a working budget that calculates your income, tracks your spending, and shows whether your plan follows the 50/30/20 guideline. You will also reflect on what you learned about both spreadsheets and personal budgeting.
